name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page numbers with an active surface that slides between pages, a window that reflows as it moves, and ellipses that fade in and out.

useCases: Paging through search results, tables, feeds, and archives, either in client state or as links to real routes such as /posts?page=3.
limitations: Pages are numbered from 1 and the component does not fetch or slice data; the caller owns the page count and the content. There is no page-size picker or jump-to-page input, and the ellipses are not clickable.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Pass pageCount, and either page with onPageChange or defaultPage. For routes, pass getHref, renderLink, or both; renderLink receives anchor props and the target page. Reduced motion moves the active surface and the number window instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/pagination.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
